_doc: Exemptions for tools/rebrand/brand-scan.mjs. Every entry needs path (glob), kind and reason. kind=permanent: the upstream name is legitimately there (attribution, vendored text, code identifiers). kind=debt: a real remaining brand string that is fixed by a known follow-up; the scan warns when a debt entry stops matching so it gets deleted. pattern (optional) is a regex tested against the raw source line. Code identifiers (@genoffice/*, GENOFFICE_* env vars, genofficeAuthPath-style names, font aliases, the lowercase `genoffice` CLI command) are masked in table.mjs and need no entry. Out of scope by construction, not scanned at all: LICENSE*, NOTICE, ee/, docs/, README*/CONTRIBUTING/PRIVACY except packages/cli/README.md (npm-published, scanned), tests, e2e, fixtures, .github.

entries.reason: Reference to an upstream issue/PR number inside a comment; attribution to where the behaviour was designed.
Comment quoting the invalid npm-scope-derived desktop name that syncDesktopName avoids; describes upstream behaviour, not product branding.
Internal note that names the removed upstream lockup to explain why placeholder artwork is in place (trademark attribution).
Vendored third-party library notes that record who made local modifications; attribution text, never rendered in the UI.

MCP resource URI scheme (genoffice://guide/*) is a protocol identifier agents address by name (skills/genoffice/SKILL.md, the CLI README), like the kept `genoffice` CLI command; renaming it breaks existing agent configs.
On-disk magic header of lazy-media stub files; changing it would orphan stubs already written by earlier versions. Never user visible.
Proxy-resolution probe against www.genspark.ai; the Genspark endpoints are removed under the telemetry/login/URL clean-up.
GENSPARK_ORIGIN cloud-projects endpoint; removed with the Genspark cloud integration.
Genspark LLM proxy base URLs and pricing-URL matcher kept for the legacy provider id until the provider is removed.
Genspark device-login and gsk tool CLI base URLs; removed with the Genspark login (GO-A4) and replaced by UniWork sign-in (GO-A5).
Referer header rule for genspark.ai-hosted images; removed with the Genspark integration.

Release / issue / homepage URLs of the flatpak, nix and docker recipes point at github.com/genspark-ai/genoffice releases, because these recipes still fetch the upstream deb / AppImage. They are repointed when the UniWork release feed exists; do not redesign the packaging before that.

Flatpak application id com.genoffice.app (manifest, .desktop, metainfo, install paths, docs) and its file names; the id moves to a UniWork reverse-DNS id together with the developer id (ai.genspark in the metainfo) and the Flathub / flatpak-builder setup.

Packaging recipes name the upstream product and vendor (Name=, descriptions, <name>, developer Mainfunc, /opt/GenOffice/genoffice) because they unpack the upstream-built deb / AppImage, which still installs under /opt/GenOffice. Rebrand with the recipes once they consume the UniWork Office artifacts (install dir /opt/UniWork Office, binary uniwork-office).
